name: Nalfeshnee
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The nalfeshnee has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nalfeshnee makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The nalfeshnee magically teleports itself, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Horror Nimbus (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The nalfeshnee magically emits scintillating, multicolored light. Each creature within 15 feet of the nalfeshnee that can see the light must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

description: Nalfeshnee are gluttonous, boar-tusked demon lords, corrupt masterminds who orchestrate the Blood War from behind the lines, teleporting away from danger while their horrific presence breaks enemy nerve.
